detail.longDescription: Authenticated RCE in the UANIA UaniaBOX, an SD-WAN appliance with no operator shell. The tcpdump filter was validated but the UBUS ACL under it was not: an authenticated user could write /etc/firewall.user, which root runs on every reload. Write-up: https:// rainpwn.blog/blog/uania-os-rce/ # infosec # bugbounty # vulnerability # research # redteam # ubus
